content.introduction: On October 6, 2026, the main stock market index of the United States, the US500, had varying reported values: one source indicated it rose to 7827 points, another to 7789 points, and a third to 7723 points. All sources agreed that the index had gained from the previous session, with changes ranging from 0.19% to 0.73%. Over the past month, the index climbed between 1.50% and 2.00%, and was up 14.99% to 16.57% compared to the same time last year. The highest value recorded was 7844.67 points on October 6, 2026, according to one source, while another recorded a highest value of 7816.70 in August 2026. The lowest value was 4.40 points. The sources do not provide a definitive answer.
